title: MILES: Modular Instruction Memory with Learnable Selection for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.06974v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly improve their reasoning at test time via additional computation, yet most existing works treat each problem in isolation. When problems arrive sequentially, accumulating reusable experience across them can further improve performance. Existing memory-based methods either store whole-solution templates that generalize poorly to novel problems or use heuristic step-level selection that is not optimized for final-answer correctness. Learning selection policies requires large-scale training data and fixed action spaces, making such approaches unsuitable for test-time settings where memory expands incrementally and only limited supervision is available. We propose MILES (Modular Instruction Memory with LEarnable Selection), a framework that dynamically expands step-wise memory and applies correctness-optimized memory composition under realistic test-time constraints. MILES maintains modular memory

translated_title: MILES：面向自改进LLM推理的模块化指令记忆与可学习选择
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过额外的计算在测试时提升其推理能力，然而大多数现有工作将每个问题孤立处理。当问题按顺序到来时，跨问题积累可复用的经验可以进一步提升性能。现有的基于记忆的方法要么存储对新问题泛化能力差的整体解法模板，要么使用未针对最终答案正确性优化的启发式步骤级选择。学习选择策略需要大规模训练数据和固定的动作空间，这使得此类方法不适用于记忆逐步扩展且仅有有限监督的现实测试时场景。我们提出了MILES（具有可学习选择的模块化指令记忆），这是一个在现实测试时约束下动态扩展步骤级记忆并应用以正确性为优化目标的记忆组合的框架。MILES维护模块化记忆
tldr: 提出MILES框架，通过动态扩展步骤级模块化指令记忆，并结合以最终答案正确性为优化目标的可学习记忆选择与组合机制，使LLM在测试时跨问题积累可复用经验、实现推理能力的自改进。
en_tdlr: MILES is a framework that dynamically expands modular step-wise instruction memory and applies learnable, correctness-optimized memory selection, enabling LLMs to accumulate reusable experience across sequentially arriving problems and self-improve reasoning under realistic test-time constraints.
